site.name: AI Agents Hub
site.tagline: Plain-English guides and daily news on AI agents

pages.angle: Definitive beginner explainer: definition, how agents differ from chatbots, the perceive-plan-act-observe loop, tools, memory, real limits.
Concrete examples grouped by domain (coding, customer support, research, sales, ops, personal), each with what it does and what it still cannot do.
Category-based buyer guide (coding, browser, research, customer service, no-code builders) with selection criteria rather than invented rankings.
Practical guide for small and mid-size businesses: high-ROI use cases, rollout steps, costs, risks, how to measure results.
Enterprise adoption: governance, security, identity and permissions, audit logs, evaluation, build vs buy.
Step-by-step technical tutorial: tool-use loop, a minimal code example in Python, adding memory, evaluation, guardrails, deployment.
What autonomy really means, levels of autonomy, human-in-the-loop design, failure modes, safety.
Running agents privately: local models, self-hosting, data residency, what leaves your machine, trade-offs.
How agents find and choose tools: function calling, MCP servers and registries, tool search, scaling to many tools.

Explainer on Moltbook, the social network built for AI agents: what it is, how agents post there, why it got attention, security concerns. Be careful to only state well-established facts and say when details are uncertain.
